text: The Fantini Group of Ortona, Italy, which produces and markets wines, is a Platinum Equity portfolio company, acquired from NB Renaissance Partners in March 2020; WineNews (June 2025) describes the Ortona-based wine group as owned by Platinum Equity.
short: The Fantini Group (Cantina Fantini) is owned by the US private-equity firm Platinum Equity.

source.name: Platinum Equity — portfolio: Fantini Group
source.quote: Fantini Group acquires grapes from local farmers, produces and markets wines under specialty labels to customers internationally
source.note: Same page, 'Transaction Description': 'Acquired from NB Renaissance Partners in March 2020'.

additionalSources.name: WineNews, 'Italian Vignerons conquering Spain: Fantini Wines takes over the former Venta la Vega winery'
additionalSources.quote: the Ortona-based wine group and export leader from Southern Italy (owned by Platinum Equity, with a record Ebitda of 27.5% and a turnover of 84 million euros in 2024
